_doc: The Bot Skill setting (Update 03 section 7): Recruit / Veteran / Elite (default Veteran). Merged over bots.json skills.<name> (turn rate, bursts, the movement layer's keys) by BotConfig.skill(). reaction_s: delay before the first shot at a new target. aim_error_deg: the initial miss when the aim swings onto a target; it converges with overshoot (overshoot: fraction swung past) and the tracking error shrinks from aim_error_deg to settle_error_deg over track_tau_s on a steady target. head_aim_mult scales the headshot preference. decision_noise: gaussian noise added to every action score (how often it picks the second-best idea). spend_smartness: chance it buys by the plan's first priority (else the second). The old names map here (bots.json skill_aliases: green -> recruit, regular -> veteran). No skill changes damage taken, ammo or health (no cheats).
